facts.fact: Cybernetica says that, to support its April 2024 to June 2025 pilot for Kenya's Ministry of ICT and ICT Authority, it put together an interoperability framework document built on the European Interoperability Framework, a high-level overview to help Kenyan organisations align; the document does not say the government adopted it (as_of is the pilot's end, June 2025; the document gives no other date).

systems.owner: Cybernetica for Ministry of ICT and ICT Authority

systems.system: Interoperability test platform and service catalogue
